# Warlock Devtools

> Package: `@warlock.js/devtools`

> Development-only dashboard for Warlock.js apps at /__warlock: request timeline, queries with EXPLAIN, N+1 detection, dev mailbox, logs, cache operations and the route map. Refuses to run outside development.

## Skills

- [devtools](@warlock.js/devtools/skills/SKILL.md): Development dashboard for Warlock apps via `devtoolsConnector`. Inspect request timelines, middleware, validation, queries, N+1 warnings, logs, cache, mail, AI runs, routes and configuration. Use for "debug a slow endpoint", "inspect this request", "view captured mail" or "open devtools". Not this package → @warlock.js/core for `warlock trace`, CLI route inspection and OpenAPI; @warlock.js/ai-panoptic for AI tracing.
